summary: Completed frontend testing of EarlyLand bug fixes. Verified favourites star size (20px), calendar breadcrumb structure, and star toggle functionality. Project detail breadcrumb testing was blocked due to Prime access requirements on activity cards.

integration_issues.issue: All activity cards show 'Prime access required' / 'Membership required' messages despite using a membership-granted test wallet. This prevented testing of project detail breadcrumbs (Feed/Prime source preservation).
affected_flows: Project detail navigation from Feed tab
Project detail navigation from Prime tab
integration_issues.note: The test wallet (0xa2a0...8001) is supposed to have an active FOMO AI membership (admin grant) but the Prime feed and activity cards are still locked. This may be a backend membership validation issue or the membership grant may not be properly configured.

passed_tests: ✅ Favourites star size: Verified star SVG is exactly 20px × 20px (expected >=18px)
✅ Favourites star visibility: Star icon is clearly visible and properly styled
✅ Calendar breadcrumb structure: Verified breadcrumb reads 'EarlyLand › Calendar' with NO 'Crypto' segment
✅ Calendar breadcrumb font size: Measured at 14px (expected ~13-14px, slightly larger than before)
✅ Calendar breadcrumb spacing: Proper top/left spacing confirmed (not flush to top)
✅ Star toggle functionality: Clicking the favourites star works without errors (regression test)
✅ Feed/Prime tabs: Both tabs are present and visible on the EarlyLand page
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Investigate why activity cards show 'Prime access required' despite using the membership-granted test wallet (0xa2a0000000000000000000000000000000008001). The wallet is supposed to have an active FOMO AI membership (admin grant) per the test data, but the Prime feed and all activity cards are locked. This blocks testing of the project detail breadcrumb functionality (Feed/Prime source preservation). Please verify: (1) Backend membership validation logic, (2) Wallet membership grant is properly configured, (3) JWT token includes correct membership claims.

success_percentage.note: 3 out of 5 test scenarios passed. Star size (PASS), Calendar breadcrumb (PASS), Star toggle (PASS). Project detail breadcrumbs from Feed/Prime tabs could not be tested due to Prime access blocking.
